name: Rotten Wife
source:
A house wife model Android is questioning her buyer about her origins and his reasoning behind her purchase.

[From [url=https://piinkpuddiin.itch.io/rotten-wife]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一台主妇型仿生人正在追问买下她的人：自己从何而来，他又为什么要买她？
